title: Stage progress
description: Status of every stage of the active plan. Updated only in the commit that closes a stage, after its verification has run.

$schema.description: Editor hint; points at this schema.

plan.description: Path to the plan file these stages come from.

updated.description: Date of the last change, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Exactly one stage is 'next' or 'in_progress' at a time.

verified.description: The command or drill that was run to close the stage, as it appears in the plan.

notes.description: Free text: what was cut, what is left, what surprised us.
